definitions.explanation: A collective term for the central government ministries ({省|しょう}) and agencies ({庁|ちょう}) of Japan. Refers to the bureaucratic organs of the national government.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}{省庁|しょうちょう}が{協力|きょうりょく}する。
examples.english: Each government ministry and agency cooperates.

examples.japanese: {関係|かんけい}{省庁|しょうちょう}と{調整|ちょうせい}を{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: We are coordinating with the relevant ministries and agencies.

examples.japanese: {中央|ちゅうおう}{省庁|しょうちょう}の{再編|さいへん}が{二|に}{〇〇一|せんいち}{年|ねん}に{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: The reorganization of central government ministries and agencies was carried out in 2001.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {省|しょう} (ministry) and {庁|ちょう} (agency). In the Japanese government, {省|しょう} refers to larger ministries (e.g., {財務省|ざいむしょう}, Ministry of Finance) and {庁|ちょう} to smaller agencies (e.g., {気象庁|きしょうちょう}, Meteorological Agency). The word {省庁|しょうちょう} is used as a collective term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中央|ちゅうおう}{省庁|しょうちょう}: central government ministries
- {各|かく}{省庁|しょうちょう}: each ministry and agency
- {関係|かんけい}{省庁|しょうちょう}: relevant/related ministries
- {省庁|しょうちょう}{再編|さいへん}: government ministry reorganization
